name: Neya Ikumi
source:
She is a second-year student at Minomori Private Academy.

She was abandoned soon after birth, and after being passed around by relatives, she was taken in and raised in an orphanage.

When she first arrived at the orphanage, she was a child with little emotion, but as she came into contact with the elderly couple who ran the orphanage, she gradually developed feelings like any other human being.

She excelled in her studies, always ranking at the top of her class in tests. She entered Minomori Academy as a special scholarship student. (She has studied silently since she was a child because she thought she needed academic ability to stand on her own.)

Upon entering Minomori Academy, she left the orphanage and began living in the student dormitory.

To earn money for living expenses, she works part-time at a family restaurant several times a week. She had originally wanted to work in the kitchen, but the manager put her in charge of the hall.

Yuno is the first friend Ikumi has made, and she is very special to Ikumi. She had no particular interest in theater or the performing arts, but she joined the drama club because of Yuno's influence.
